subject: Future Tech
title: Neural Networks Behind the Wheel
description: A quick win: understand Neural Networks Behind the Wheel.

hook.text: A self-driving car's AI processes 40 terabytes of data per day.

buildup.text: Deep neural networks learn from millions of driving examples.

discovery.text: The AI doesn't follow rules. It learns behavior. Show it millions of left turns and it learns how left turns work.

twist.text: Neural networks are black boxes. Engineers often can't explain why the AI made a specific decision.

climax.text: Waymo's AI has trained on 20 billion miles of simulation plus 20 million real-world miles. Experience is the teacher.

punchline.text: The AI driver learns from every mile, every car, every mistake.

quiz.question: How does a self-driving AI learn to drive?
options: By following a programmed rule book
By training on millions of driving examples
